mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly higher when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly lower when UNRATE rises above 4.0% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO and HOUST rising together does not produce positive returns in more than 60% of instances (p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%), the S&P 500 is expected to have negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to central bank tightening and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly lower when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) are associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as increased housing activity signals stronger consumer demand and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly higher when HOUST is above its 12-month median (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in employment (PAYEMS) above 100,000 persons signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly higher when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly higher when HOUST is above its 12-month median (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly higher when INDPRO is above its 12-month median (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.
